summary: Day 9 of 72 (Weekly Consolidation Drill & Sectional Error Log Review): Consolidate Week 2 gains: solve 30 mixed Arithmetic problems under strict timer, and re-attempt all missed questions.

urgent_alerts.title: APS India Courier Document Dispatch
urgent_alerts.action: Courier physical document packet (Semesters 1–8 marksheets, degree certificate, DigiLocker consent) to APS New Delhi.

blocks.title: DSA Algorithmic Problem Solving (2 Problems)
blocks.details: Solve 2 curated LeetCode problems (1 Medium + 1 Easy/Review) from the 247-problem DSA Tracker. Focus on algorithmic clarity and edge cases.

blocks.title: Job Search Recruiter Triage & Screening Replies
blocks.details: 15–30 min recruiter communications triage: reply to inbound messages, confirm availability, schedule technical screenings, and follow up on pending submissions.

blocks.title: CAT Day 9: QA & DILR Focus
blocks.details: QA: Timed 30-Question Arithmetic Blitz (Percentages, P&L, Ratios, SI-CI) in 60 minutes. Log any formula hesitation.. DILR: Timed DILR 2-Set Challenge (solve 2 arrangement sets back-to-back in 25 minutes). Grade yourself with Anastasis solutions..

blocks.title: Germany Academic Admin & Prerequisite Audits
blocks.details: Zero-fee audit tasks: Check Anabin H+ status for MDU, audit dMAT status on aps-india.de/dmat, review Passau interactive guide checklist, and email MDU for 100% English MOI letter.

blocks.title: CAT Day 9: VARC & Verbal Ability
blocks.details: Read 1 philosophy essay on AL Daily. Review all 5 RC error log entries from Week 2 to spot recurrent trap choices. Maintain error log on Career Launcher MyZone.
